why: Round 4's frozen rule advanced both variants and picked KM_gl, the per-layer-a_l family. This round confirms it on instances that round 4 did not fit. KM_pack also advanced and is not confirmed here.
hamiltonian: sum_{i<j} J_ij Z_i Z_j + 0.1 sum_i X_i, J iid Normal(0,1), SeedSequence([20261115, N, k])
k_not_used: k=4..15 were the development set. k=44..59 are reserved for a KM_pack confirmation only if this round does not confirm KM_gl at N=9 and does not confirm it at N=12.

families.KM_gl: per-layer a_l on Hc, shared b and c, interleaved packing, 2+4L. Not the retained KM family. Nested from KM so its energy is at most KM's
families.qaoa: independent gamma_l and beta_l, round-3 standard budget, 2L

box: same as rounds 3 and 4: every linear coefficient and each QAOA gamma in [-2pi/s_J, 2pi/s_J], shells and beta in [-2pi, 2pi]
seeds: the round-4 formulas, which include k, so these instances do not reuse any round-4 draw
selection: lowest energy within a repeat; primary is the lower of the two. No ground state, eigenvector, E0 or fidelity in features, starts, beam or selection.
primary_metric: F_sub within 1e-6 of E0, all N, after selection

per_N_all_required: Holm-adjusted one-sided sign-test p < 0.05 across the three N, ties excluded
95% bootstrap CI lower bound of median (F - F_QAOA) > 0
median (F - F_QAOA) >= median (F_KM - F_QAOA) on the same instances
at L=5, median (F - F_QAOA) > 0 and wins >= losses
each repeat's own selection has median (F - F_QAOA) > 0
replay gate passes at that N
confirmation.overall: confirmed if every N passes; partial if N=6 and at least one of N=9 or N=12 pass; not confirmed otherwise. No claim of global optimality.
confirmation.fallback: if KM_gl is not confirmed at N=9 and not confirmed at N=12, one further round confirms KM_pack on k=44..59 under this same rule. If KM_gl is confirmed at N=9 or N=12, stop.

job_order: k ascending, within k N=12 then 9 then 6, repeats inner
